title: Finite coefficient change for the dualizing object
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], so $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ has characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and integers $1\le m\le n$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^n)$ and $B=A_{E,m}$, with their quotient map $A\to B$. Let $a_X:X\to s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ be separated and of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Work first on the ordinary small etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with derived coefficient extension $T_{A,B}(K)=K\otimes_A^L B$ [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Let $F_{X,A}=Ra_{X,A!}$ be ordinary etale compact support [def-amb-etale-compact-support], let $a_{X,A}^{\times}$ be its right adjoint [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], and set $\omega_{X,A}=a_{X,A}^{\times}A_s$; use the analogous notation at $B$. Denote the counit at $A_s$ by $\varepsilon_{X,A}:F_{X,A}\omega_{X,A}\to A_s$.

There is a canonical isomorphism
$$
u_{X,A,B}:T_{A,B}\omega_{X,A}\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_{X,B}.
$$
Specifically, let $c_{X,A,B,K}:T_{A,B}F_{X,A}K\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{X,B}T_{A,B}K$ be the compact-support coefficient comparison of [lem-fix-compact-support-coefficient-change]. Then $u_{X,A,B}$ is the adjoint under $F_{X,B}\dashv a_{X,B}^{\times}$ of
$$
F_{X,B}T_{A,B}\omega_{X,A}\xrightarrow{c_{X,A,B,\omega_{X,A}}^{-1}}T_{A,B}F_{X,A}\omega_{X,A}\xrightarrow{T_{A,B}\varepsilon_{X,A}}T_{A,B}A_s\cong B_s.
$$
In particular its counit identity is
$$
\varepsilon_{X,B}\circ F_{X,B}(u_{X,A,B})=(T_{A,B}\varepsilon_{X,A})\circ c_{X,A,B,\omega_{X,A}}^{-1}.
$$
For $1\le h\le m\le n$ and $C=A_{E,h}$ these isomorphisms satisfy
$$
u_{X,A,C}=u_{X,B,C}\circ T_{B,C}(u_{X,A,B}),\qquad u_{X,A,A}=1,
$$
using the canonical reassociation $T_{B,C}T_{A,B}\cong T_{A,C}$. Their finite pro-etale realization is the same isomorphism after the etale/pro-etale comparison: the dualizing objects are identified by [lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison], and the exceptional functor on that constructible realization is the transported functor of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image].

proof.text: Prove compact-support coefficient comparison invertible by its proper and open factors, using properFiniteCoefficientExtension and functor preservation of isomorphisms. The counit equation is symm_apply_apply for the defining exceptional homEquiv.

Apply affine-restriction invertibility. The existing ordinary etale theorem isIso_of_isIso_mapDerivedCategoryUpperStar_map_of_jointlySurjective in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.UpperShriekLocality descends this along all affine opens. It follows by exact pullback commuting with homology, joint conservativity of covering sheaf restrictions, and DerivedCategory.isIso_iff.

Apply coefficientCounitMate_identity and coefficientCounitMate_cocycle to the proper/open normalization equations. All four comparison components are invertible by the first step, including the intermediate extended object. Replace the total comparison inverse by the actual inverse and cancel the scalar associator with its inverse. This gives the specified etale unit and quotient cocycle.

Specialize arbitrary-family scalar realization to the actual ordinary and intrinsic dualizing terms, the normalized origin isomorphisms, and the proved etale comparisons. Its transitions are definitionally the prescribed exceptional transitions; obtain intrinsic invertibility and the restriction unit and cocycle. Assemble all six clauses.
